subcategory_text: Provide role-appropriate security education, training, and guidance to all stakeholders involved in the software lifecycle.
implementation_examples: L1: Provide baseline secure-development training to all engineers
L2: Provide role-based training (e.g., architects, devops, QA) with refreshers
L3: Track training effectiveness via assessments and behaviour change
assessment_objectives: Determine whether role-based security training is provided.
Determine whether training effectiveness is measured.
